Close connections after use; retain no idle connections.

Medium is the default (2 chains). Jump hosts count as part of a chain. Idle connections do not poll task status and are closed when the app enters the background. Active connections are separate.
Preparing to open: finishing current status reads…

On: hides connection addresses and usernames; normal pages can be captured. Off: shows connection details; screenshots are blocked. Credential, connection detail and fingerprint pages are always protected. Terminal output and custom names are not redacted.
